item.title: Anode-free zinc batteries enabled by structurally robust solid–electrolyte interphase
item.content:encoded:
Nature Sustainability, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01993-7

Zinc metal batteries are sustainable, but deep cycling triggers a catastrophic structural collapse of the solid–electrolyte interphase. By retaining trace reserved zinc during stripping, this work prevents solid–electrolyte interphase degradation, enabling a 99.96% Coulombic efficiency and stable anode-free pouch cells.
